scenes.headline: How a search loop rewrites its own scheduler
scenes.sub: Dream-RSI tests new search policies by replaying its past attempts.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Buttons! Dream-RSI, from Google and DeepMind, is a loop that gets better at searching. Here's what actually improves, round after round.

scenes.text: Keep every model frozen. Each round, rewrite only the Python scheduler that spends the search budget, and test new versions by replaying cached past attempts.
scenes.say: The idea: keep every model frozen. Each round, rewrite only the Python scheduler that spends the search budget, and test new versions by replaying past attempts.

steps.say: An exploration policy picks which attempts to extend, and how many in parallel. A frozen discovery agent writes each one.
A fixed evaluator scores it, and every outcome is saved in a discovery tree.

steps.note: zero new discovery-agent or evaluator calls
steps.say: Between rounds, a second frozen agent rewrites the policy, and tests each version by dreaming: replaying it on the saved trees, with no new discovery calls.
The version with the best average replay score redeploys online, and the next round begins.

scenes.title: The replay score
scenes.say: Replay scores each candidate with one formula.

parts.note: the best result the replayed search reaches
minus a cost for every attempt spent
parts.say: minus a cost for every attempt spent,

parts.note: plus a bonus for batching useful probes in parallel
parts.say: plus a bonus for batching useful probes instead of running them one by one.

scenes.title: What recurses, and what never changes

left.title: Frozen, every round
items: The discovery agent's weights and prompt
left.say: Frozen, every round: the discovery agent's weights and prompt, the evaluator, and the rewriting agent too.

right.title: Rewritten, every round
right.say: What recurses is about a hundred and fifty lines of scheduler code, and the growing history it reads.

scenes.label: comparisons against its own matched baseline
scenes.note: the rewriting agent's own calls are never counted
scenes.say: Against an identical baseline that never rewrites its policy, it wins eight of nine comparisons, several at lower compute. The rewriting agent's own calls go uncounted.

scenes.text: Past attempts are a free simulator: replaying them lets a scheduler improve without touching any model.

recap: A frozen agent searches; a policy schedules it
Policies are tested by replaying saved trees
Only the scheduler changes, round to round
scenes.say: To recap: a frozen searcher, and a scheduler tested by dreaming on saved trees.
